meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit by kind of borrower and occupation, every quarter since March 2014
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 958 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (6 values, e.g. Co-operative sector, Mining and Quarrying, credit limits on 2022-06-01; Co-operative sector, Mining and Quarrying, credit outstanding on 2020-03-01; General State Government, Mining and Quarrying, credit limits on 2024-12-01).
